TypeSignalsError only transports execution failures after the per-layer freshness decision; it cannot establish the all-input comparison or skip invariant owned by the evaluator and reuse-decision entries.

TypeSignalsError is an error-transport type and has no snapshot-read, parse, hash-validation, or reuse-decision surface; those behaviors are owned by RustdocSchemaExporter and TypeSignalsReuseDecision.
TypeSignalsError reports a failed command but does not persist schema-versioned freshness identities or select conservative recomputation; artifact and evaluator entries own that behavior.
TypeSignalsRequest carries command inputs and layer selection but neither stores current freshness identities nor makes the per-layer reuse decision required by this invariant.
TypeSignalsRequest does not resolve or normalize Cargo build-input closures; that layer-granular responsibility belongs to the infrastructure build-input evaluator.
